# ITAA

> ITAA provides expert global technology and commercial advisory services specializing in software license optimization, asset management, and procurement for enterprises.

ITAA is a leading software licensing consultancy serving global businesses with specialized expertise in managing licenses for major publishers including IBM, Microsoft, Oracle, and SAP. The firm offers comprehensive services spanning software asset management (SAM), license compliance, audit defense, procurement optimization, and the Assist platform for vendor negotiation and compliance management.

## Key Topics

- Software License Optimization
- Software Asset Management (SAM)
- License Compliance
- Audit Defense
- IBM Licensing
- Microsoft Licensing
- Software Procurement
- Cost Optimization
- Contract Negotiation
- Vendor Management
- ILMT (IBM License Metric Tool)
- PVU/RVU Licensing
- Commercial Advisory
- Supply Chain Management
- Software Transformation

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://itaa.com/services): ITAA services overview: software advisory, SAM, procurement, compliance
- [Software Advisory](https://itaa.com/services/software-advisory): Software license optimization for SAP, IBM, Oracle, Microsoft
- [Software Asset Management](https://itaa.com/services/software-asset-management): Software asset management and SAM services with baseline assessment
- [Commercial Procurement](https://itaa.com/services/commercial-procurement): Software procurement and licensing consultancy with cost optimization
- [Assist Platform](https://itaa.com/services/assist): Assist platform: licensing support, vendor negotiation, compliance management

## IBM Licensing Solutions

- [IBM Software Licensing Support](https://itaa.com/ibm): IBM software audit defense and license optimization services
- [IBM Audit Defense](https://itaa.com/ibm/ibm-audit-defense): IBM audit defense with compliance assessment and settlement negotiation
- [IBM License Compliance & Optimization](https://itaa.com/ibm/ibm-license-compliance-optimization): IBM license compliance with PVU/RVU licensing and cost reduction
- [IBM Contract Negotiation](https://itaa.com/ibm/ibm-contract-negotiation): IBM contract negotiation and enterprise agreement pricing support
- [ILMT Installation & Support](https://itaa.com/ibm/ilmt-implementation): ILMT installation and BigFix deployment for license compliance
- [IBM License Management Tools](https://itaa.com/ibm/license-management-tools): IBM license management tools: Blue-LM, ILMT, PVU calculations
- [Red Hat Licensing](https://itaa.com/ibm/red-hat): Red Hat licensing optimization, audit support, and subscription management
